responsibility: Defines the variance inference query providers and coordinates the module's full crate-level pipeline: allocate inference terms, collect constraints, solve them, and expose per-item inferred variances through `crate_variances` and `variances_of`.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `outlives/mod.rs`, which computes inferred outlives predicates, this `mod.rs` drives the separate crate-wide variance inference pipeline and exposes variance query providers for items' generic parameters.
